source.label: Li's coefficients of a finite configuration with off-line pairs

reviewer: Claude Code proof assessment; fresh medium reviewer

claims.summary: For a finite multiset of complex points other than 0 and 1, closed under conjugation and rho -> 1 - conj(rho), with lambda_n = sum m(1 - (1 - 1/rho)^n): lambda_n = S_on(n) + sum over off-line pairs of m(2 - (r^n + r^-n) cos n phi) with S_on >= 0; with tau = delta/(min(beta, 1-beta)^2 + gamma^2), lambda_n >= S_on(n) - 4 sum m sinh^2(n tau/2), so for n <= 1/tau_max the off-line pairs lower lambda_n by less than 1.09 each and lambda_n < 0 forces n tau_max > log(S_on(n)/M_off); and any off-line point makes lambda_n negative for infinitely many n.
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof (partner pairs have reciprocal-conjugate w; Dirichlet simultaneous approximation for the last part). Finite model of Li's criterion with the index threshold of order gamma^2/delta for a pair at height gamma and distance delta. Nothing is derived about the coefficients of zeta; the criterion's sources are not read.
claims.rationale: Locates the index range in which Li's positivity could detect an off-line zero at a given height: of order height squared over distance.
claims.next_action: Read a source for the arithmetic formula of the coefficients and for what is known unconditionally at large index.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proof in the entry; no computation.
notes.significance: Context: the last part is the finite model of a known criterion; the threshold form is elementary. Novelty not claimed.
notes.relationships: Analogous to the pair atom's exponential weight in the Gram model, with n/gamma^2 in the place of the bandwidth.

relationships: The pair's weight exp(n delta/gamma^2) is the analogue of kappa at bandwidth n/gamma^2; an analogy, no estimate transferred.
